text: Finished my first marathon. 4:41. Cried at the finish line. I did that.
Spoke up in the meeting even though my voice shook. Said exactly what I meant.
Ayo got into medical school. First in our family to go to university. I'm bursting.
Six months clean today.
Built the bookshelf myself. It's level. I checked with a spirit level three times.
Paid off the last of the student loan. Ten years. Done.
My daughter stood up for a kid who was being picked on. The teacher called to tell me. I'm so proud of her.
Got my black belt after six years of training. Sensei Kim said I earned every stripe.
Held a boundary with Mum today without yelling or caving. Calm, clear, kind. Proud of that.
The app I built is live. 300 users in the first day. Strangers using a thing I made!
Finally said no to an extra project. Nobody died. Growth.
Matías played his first solo at the school concert. He didn't look at the audience once. Perfect.
Defended my thesis! Doctor of philosophy. Mum calls me 'Doctor' in every message now.
Cooked a three-course dinner for eight and nothing burnt. Who am I.
Quietly proud that I went to the gym four times this week. Small thing. Big for me.
Our team raised £12,000 for the hospice. Rhiannon cried when we announced the total.
Taught Grandma to video call. She called me four times to practise. Proud of us both.
Passed the citizenship test. Studied for months in my second language.
I handled the angry customer really well today. Stayed calm, solved it, he left smiling.
Our little shop turned a profit for the first time. Framed the receipt.
Swam a whole length without stopping. Learning at 45 is humbling and I did it.
I called the doctor about the thing I've been avoiding for months. Appointment booked. Adulting.
Watched Freya graduate today. From the girl who hid under tables to valedictorian.
First painting sold at the market. To a stranger! For real money!
Kept my temper when Adrian pushed every button. Walked away instead. I'm learning.
Fixed the bike myself with a YouTube video and stubbornness.
The patient I've been working with for months walked out of rehab on his own today. I helped make that happen.
Wrote 50,000 words this month. It's a messy draft but it's a whole novel.
My little brother got his first job and called me before anyone else. I helped him write his CV.
I gave the speech at Dad's memorial and got through it without breaking down. He'd have liked it.
Fourteen days without a cigarette. Hardest thing I've ever done. Still doing it.
Learned to say 'I don't know' at work without feeling stupid. Big deal for me.
The garden won second prize in the village show. Mr. Peabody won first. He always does.
Juliette's first word was 'book'. I've been reading to her every night since she was born.
Ran the meeting for the first time. Nobody noticed I was nervous. I think I'm good at this.
Proud of how I handled the breakup. Honest, kind, no drama.
Got the highest mark in the class on the stats exam. Me, who failed maths at school.
Volunteered at the shelter for a year now. Tonight a regular, Gerald, said I'm the reason he keeps coming back.
Hiked to the summit with my bad knee. Slow, but I got there.
Asked for the raise. Got it. Practised the speech twenty times but I delivered it once, perfectly.
The kids cleaned their rooms without being asked. I must be doing something right.
Finished the quilt for Shanthi's baby. 200 hours of stitching. Every square has a meaning.
Passed my probation period. They said I'm 'exceeding expectations'. Screenshotted it.
I asked for help today instead of struggling alone. That's new. Proud of myself.
Daniyar won the science fair with his water filter. Watching him explain it to the judges, I nearly burst.
Organised the whole conference. 400 people. No disasters. Everyone thanked me.
Wore the dress I've been too nervous to wear. Felt great all day.
Six months of therapy and today I caught the spiral before it started. That's the work paying off.
Our community garden opened today. Three years of meetings, petitions and digging. Councillor Ahmed cut the ribbon.
Got my driving licence at 52. Never too late.
Translated Grandad's war letters for the family. Took a year. Everyone cried at the reading.
The student who said she hated reading asked me for book recommendations. Teaching win.
Pleased with myself for not checking emails all holiday. First time ever.
I was so scared to perform but I sang the whole song and Ama said she got goosebumps.
Lost 15 kilos this year by walking every day. Doctor's thrilled. So am I.
My team shipped the hardest release of the year and I led it. Hands still shaking a bit.
Small win: I finally learned to make my mum's flatbread. Tastes almost like hers.
Henri performed his first stand-up set. Terrible jokes. Brave as anything. So proud.
I didn't drink at the party. First time in years. Had a great time anyway.
Finished the hardest course of the degree with a distinction.
Stood my ground with the landlord and got the deposit back in full. Bit chuffed.
Climbed the wall I fell off last month. Topped out. Bao cheered from the bottom.
Didn't give up on the jigsaw. 2000 pieces. Two months. Complete.
Proud of Lucia for leaving that job. It took real courage.
Got through a whole family dinner without a single argument. I steered three conversations away from politics.
Published my first research paper. My name, in a journal, forever.
Learned to swim this summer. Jumped off the jetty today without holding my nose.
Coached the under-10s to their first win. They poured water on me. Worth it.
Renewed my nursing licence. Twenty years in. Still love it. Still good at it.
I went to the party alone and talked to new people. Old me would've stayed home.
